module1.desc: Automates statutory books mapped to tax calculation regimes: S1a-HKD (under threshold), S2a-HKD (% of revenue), and the 4-book bundle S2b, S2c, S2d, S2e (tax on taxable income). Audit-ready 24/7.

module2.name: Automated E-Invoice Reconciliation
module2.desc: Extracts and cross-references input and output e-invoices directly from tax authorities. Validates verification codes against ledgers, eliminating tax penalty risks.

module3.desc: Ingests transactional feeds from retail POS terminals, banking QR codes, and corporate accounts. Automatically logs revenue without manual data entry.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Pricing Questions
faq.q1: Do I need a credit card to sign up for the 14-day free trial?
faq.a1: No credit card required. Simply register with your phone number or email. You get full access to automated bank ledger ingestion for 14 days completely risk-free.
faq.q2: Why should I choose annual billing over monthly billing?
faq.a2: Over 90% of Vietnamese businesses choose annual billing to save 20% on subscription costs and receive a single, compliant VAT invoice for simple tax deduction.
faq.q3: Is my financial data secure when connecting bank accounts?
faq.a3: Bank connections utilize read-only Open Banking and VietQR webhooks encrypted with AES-256 bank-grade cryptography. A-Sổ cannot execute transfers or alter your accounts.
faq.q4: Do you support data migration from legacy tools or paper records?
faq.a4: Yes. Our team provides complimentary white-glove onboarding, importing opening balances and product lists within 30 minutes.
